# Read Me
To run the following analyses, please have the following packages installed:\
- tidyverse\
- psych\
- effectsize\
- ggplot2\

If you are unfamiliar with R, packages can be installed using install.packages("packageName"). You can do this by running the commented(#) text under "Data Preparation"\
\
The analyses in this file are ordered based on the order that they appear in the paper.\

Explanation of variable names:\
- diff: Looking time towards unfair test event minus looking time towards fair test event\
- prop: proportion of looking time towards unfair test trial for each participant\
- ttype: type of test trial (ie fair or unfair)\
- condition: aggressor, protector, victim, bystander, random (also labelled control)\

# Data Preparation
```{r}
# install.packages("tidyverse")
# install.packages("psych")
# install.packages("effectsize")
# install.packages("ggplot2")
# install.packages("lme4")
# Load Packages
library(psych)
library(tidyverse)
library(effectsize)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
```

# Experiment 1

```{r}
# Load Data
exp_1_data <- read.csv("exp1_data.csv")
names(exp_1_data)[1] <- "condition"


# Variable for total familiarization looking time
exp_1_data$fam_total <- exp_1_data$fam_1 + exp_1_data$fam_2 + exp_1_data$fam_3 + exp_1_data$fam_4

# Convert condition and subject number to factor
exp_1_data$condition <- as.factor(exp_1_data$condition)
exp_1_data$Subject.Number <- as.factor(exp_1_data$Subject.Number)

# Data in long format
exp_1_data_long <- gather(exp_1_data, ttype, LT, Fair.LT:Unfair.LT)

# Filter by condition
exp_1_aggressor <- filter(exp_1_data, condition == "Aggressor")
exp_1_protector <- filter(exp_1_data, condition == "Protector")
exp_1_victim <- filter(exp_1_data, condition == "Victim")
exp_1_bystander <- filter(exp_1_data, condition == "Bystander")
exp_1_control <- filter(exp_1_data, condition == "Control")
```



# Omnibus ANOVA

```{r}
model <- aov(LT ~ condition*ttype + Error(Subject.Number/ttype), data = exp_1_data_long)
summary(model)
eta_squared(model, alternative = "two.sided")
```

# Analyses By Condition

## Aggressor Condition Analyses
```{r}
# t-test
aggressor.t <- t.test(formula = diff ~ 1, data = exp_1_aggressor)
aggressor.t
cohens_d(exp_1_aggressor$diff, paired = TRUE)

# binomial test
binom.test(sum(exp_1_aggressor$diff > 1), sum(exp_1_aggressor$diff > 1, exp_1_aggressor$diff < -1), p = .5, alternative = "two.sided")
```
## Aggressor Means and SEs
```{r}
# Means and SDs
mean(exp_1_aggressor$Fair.LT)
sd(exp_1_aggressor$Fair.LT)/sqrt(32)
mean(exp_1_aggressor$Unfair.LT)
sd(exp_1_aggressor$Unfair.LT)/sqrt(32)
mean(exp_1_aggressor$diff)
sd(exp_1_aggressor$diff)/sqrt(32)
```

### analyses correcting for multiple comparisons
```{r}
model <- aov(prop ~ condition, data = exp_1_data)
TukeyHSD(model, conf.level=.95)
pairwise.t.test(x = exp_1_data$prop, g = exp_1_data$condition, p.adjust.method = "none")

model <- aov(diff ~ condition, data = exp_1_data)
TukeyHSD(model, conf.level=.95)
pairwise.t.test(x = exp_1_data$diff, g = exp_1_data$condition, p.adjust.method = "none")
```

# Visualization
```{r}
exp_1_data_long$condition <- as.character(exp_1_data_long$condition)
exp_1_data_long$condition[exp_1_data_long$condition == "agressor"] <- "Aggressor"
exp_1_data_long$condition[exp_1_data_long$condition == "Control"] <- "Random"
exp_1_data_long$condition[exp_1_data_long$condition == "protector"] <- "Protector"
exp_1_data_long$condition[exp_1_data_long$condition == "bystander"] <- "Bystander"
exp_1_data_long$condition[exp_1_data_long$condition == "victim"] <- "Victim"
exp_1_data_long$ttype[exp_1_data_long$ttype == "Fair.LT"] <- "Fair"
exp_1_data_long$ttype[exp_1_data_long$ttype == "Unfair.LT"] <- "Unfair"

exp_1_data_long$condition <- factor(exp_1_data_long$condition, levels = c("Protector", "Victim","Random", "Bystander", "Aggressor"))
ggplot(data= exp_1_data_long, aes(x = ttype, y = LT, fill = ttype)) + facet_wrap(~condition, nrow=1) +
  geom_line(aes(group=Subject.Number))+
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, coef = 0) +
  geom_jitter(width=0.02) + 
  ylab("Time Looking at Test Trial\n(in sec)") +  
  xlab("Test Trial Type") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  theme_classic() +  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#F57F17", "#1E88E5")) + 
  guides(fill=guide_legend(title="Test Trial Type")) +
  stat_summary(geom = "point", fun.y = "mean", col = "black", size = 3, shape = 23, fill = "red") +
  theme(text = element_text(size=10),
        plot.title = element_text(size=20),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=15),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=15),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=15),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=15),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.title = element_text(size=15),
      legend.text = element_text(size=15))

ggsave("Experiment 1 Results.png", width = 9, height = 6)

exp_1_data$condition <- as.character(exp_1_data$condition)
exp_1_data$condition[exp_1_data$condition == "Control"] <- "Random"

exp_1_data$condition <- factor(exp_1_data$condition, levels = c( "Protector", "Victim",  "Random", "Bystander","Aggressor"))
ggplot(data= exp_1_data, aes(x = condition, y = prop)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, coef = 0) +
  geom_jitter(width=0.02) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed") +
  ylab("Proportion Looking to \nUnfair Trial") +  
  xlab("Condition") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  theme_classic() +  
  stat_summary(geom = "point", fun.y = "mean", col = "black", size = 3, shape = 23, fill = "red") +
  theme(text = element_text(size=10),
        plot.title = element_text(size=20),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=15),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=15),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=20),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=20),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.title = element_text(size=15),
      legend.text = element_text(size=15))

ggsave("Experiment 1 Proportion Results.png", width = 9, height = 6)
```

# Experiment 2

```{r}
exp_2_data <- read.csv("exp2_data.csv")
exp_2_data$Subject.Number <- as.factor(exp_2_data$Subject.Number)
exp_2_data$daycare_presence[exp_2_data$daycare_hours == 1] <- 0
exp_2_data$daycare_presence[exp_2_data$daycare_hours > 1] <- .5
exp_2_data$daycare_presence[exp_2_data$daycare_hours > 4] <- 1
exp_2_data$sibling_presence[exp_2_data$siblings > 0] <- 1
exp_2_data$sibling_presence[exp_2_data$siblings < 1] <- 0
exp_2_data$daycare_composite <- exp_2_data$daycare_presence + exp_2_data$sibling_presence

exp_2_long_data <- pivot_longer(data = exp_2_data, cols = c("Unfair.LT", "Fair.LT"), names_to = "ttype", values_to = "LT")

exp_2_intervener <- exp_2_data %>%
  filter(condition == "Intervener")
exp_2_aggressor <- exp_2_data %>% 
  filter(condition == "Aggressor")

exp_2_intervener_long <- exp_2_intervener %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Unfair.LT", "Fair.LT"), names_to = "ttype", values_to = "LT")
exp_2aggressor_long <- exp_2_aggressor %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Unfair.LT", "Fair.LT"), names_to = "ttype", values_to = "LT")

combined_data <- read.csv("combined_data.csv")
combined_data$Subject.Number <- as.factor(combined_data$Subject.Number)

combined_aggressor <- filter(combined_data, condition == "Aggressor")
combined_intervener <- filter(combined_data, condition == "Intervener")

combined_long <- combined_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Unfair.LT", "Fair.LT"), names_to = "ttype", values_to = "LT")
combined_aggressor_long <- combined_long %>% 
  filter(condition == "Aggressor")
combined_intervener_long <- combined_long %>% 
  filter(condition == "Intervener")

exp_2_data_fam <- gather(exp_2_data, fam_num, LT, fam_1:fam_4)
order <- c("Intervener", "Aggressor")

exp_2_data_fam$condition <- factor(exp_2_data_fam$condition, levels = order)
```

# ANOVA
```{r}
model <- aov(LT ~ condition*ttype + Error(Subject.Number/ttype), data = exp_2_long_data)
summary(model)
eta_squared(model, alternative = "two.sided", ci = .95)
```

# t-test and binomial tests
```{r}
t.test(exp_2_intervener$Unfair.LT, exp_2_intervener$Fair.LT, paired = T)
cohens_d(exp_2_intervener$Unfair.LT, exp_2_intervener$Fair.LT, paired = T)
binom.test(sum(exp_2_intervener$diff > 1), sum(exp_2_intervener$diff > 1, exp_2_intervener$diff < -1), p = .5, alternative = "two.sided")

t.test(exp_2_aggressor$Unfair.LT, exp_2_aggressor$Fair.LT, paired = T)
cohens_d(exp_2_aggressor$Unfair.LT, exp_2_aggressor$Fair.LT, paired = T)
binom.test(sum(exp_2_aggressor$diff > 1), sum(exp_2_aggressor$diff > 1, exp_2_aggressor$diff < -1), p = .5, alternative = "two.sided")
```

# Visualization
```{r}
exp_2_long_data$condition <- as.character(exp_2_long_data$condition)
exp_2_long_data$condition[exp_2_long_data$condition == "Intervener"] <- "Protector"
exp_2_long_data$ttype[exp_2_long_data$ttype == "Fair.LT"] <- "Fair"
exp_2_long_data$ttype[exp_2_long_data$ttype == "Unfair.LT"] <- "Unfair"

exp_2_long_data$condition <- factor(exp_2_long_data$condition, levels = c("Protector", "Aggressor"))

ggplot(data= exp_2_long_data, aes(x = ttype, y = LT, fill = ttype)) + facet_wrap(~condition, nrow=1) +
  geom_line(aes(group=Subject.Number))+
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, coef = 0) +
  geom_jitter(width=0.02) + 
  ylab("Time Looking at Test Trial\n(in sec)") +  
  xlab("Test Trial Type") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  theme_classic() +  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#F57F17", "#1E88E5")) + 
  guides(fill=guide_legend(title="Test Trial Type")) +
  stat_summary(geom = "point", fun.y = "mean", col = "black", size = 3, shape = 23, fill = "red") +
  theme(text = element_text(size=10),
        plot.title = element_text(size=20),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=15),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=15),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=15),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=15),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.title = element_text(size=15),
      legend.text = element_text(size=15))

ggsave("Experiment 2 Results.png", width = 6, height = 6)
```
